name: everything-addable-is-rmable
body: Every entity that can be added must be removable. Add `rm` for the plan entities that currently lack it: `apg plan rm <project>`, `apg plan rm <project> phase <n>`, `apg plan rm <project> task <phase> <k>`, `apg plan rm <project> planned <fqn>` (node/edge rm already exist). `rm` on a non-existent entity is an error, never a silent no-op. Acceptance: each listed entity can be removed; removing an absent one exits non-zero.
